sources.entry: Recall - Summarize YouTube videos, blog posts, PDFs, articles or any other online content. #freemium

summary.name: Recall
summary.one_liner: Recall is an AI knowledge base and summarizer that turns saved YouTube videos, podcasts, PDFs and articles into summaries, quizzes and a searchable, chattable personal library.
use_cases: Summarizing YouTube videos and podcast episodes
Saving articles and PDFs for later research
Studying with AI-generated quizzes and spaced repetition
Building a personal knowledge base to chat with
Deep research on a topic across saved sources
summary.what_it_does: Recall lets you save videos, podcasts, PDFs, articles and other online content in one click. It generates summaries that can be read or listened to, including in a cloned voice. Saved items are auto-tagged, linked to related content and shown in a knowledge graph. You can chat with your saved material using GPT, Claude or Gemini models. It also creates automated quizzes on a spaced repetition schedule to help with memory.
notable: Chat with saved content using GPT, Claude or Gemini
Auto-tagged knowledge graph with connected ideas
AI quizzes on a spaced repetition schedule
caveats: Premium tier exists; a 30-day refund applies to Premium
Free YouTube and podcast summarizers are offered as separate entry points
Augmented browsing is local first, but the knowledge base is stored in the cloud
